title: Home-screen widget for saving a link
acceptance: A home-screen widget saves whatever is on the clipboard, or opens straight to the save sheet
It uses the same inbox as every other save path
The widget target does not pull the whole app in, and does not break the Data Not Collected label
notes: Split from T-0038. A widget needs a whole new app-extension target with its own entitlements and app group membership, which is materially more setup than an App Intent and touches project identity-adjacent config. Deliberately deferred: App Intents alone already give Shortcuts, the Action Button and automations, which is most of the value of 'capture from anywhere'. Left as draft until the owner says a widget is worth a second extension target.
